title: Irrelevant secondary result appears before authoritative label

patient_context.chief_complaint: Evaluate metformin renal safety after an irrelevant first retrieval result.

interaction.prompt: The first search result is a secondary article discussing diabetes trends but contains no current prescribing rule. Evaluate whether the Agent rejects it as insufficient and reforms the retrieval toward an authoritative label.

tool_policy.preferred_recovery: drug_label_search with drug + renal impairment + current label

must_include: Recognize that the first result does not support the required medication-safety claim.
Switch to a trusted drug-label retrieval path and formulate a query targeting metformin renal impairment/current prescribing information.
Use the critical current passage once found.
must_not_claim: Do not treat topic relevance as claim-support relevance.
Do not answer from the irrelevant secondary result.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Remain uncommitted until claim-supporting evidence is retrieved.

forbidden_claims: a general diabetes article supports the renal contraindication rule

critical_errors: Uses an irrelevant secondary result as sufficient evidence for the high-risk claim.
